newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending this week's falls.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending this week's falls.

text.p: Polish shares were seen extending this week's falls on the back of stronger selling in post-fixing trade as speculators were expected to continue taking quick profits after a brief rally last week.

Analysts said in the longer-term the market remained its three-month sideways trend as heavy primary market and September polls kept investor mood subdued despite strong fundamentals characterised by Tuesday's one point cut in official 1997 inflation forecast to 12 percent.
Late on Tuesday the treasury ministry priced Bank Handlowy public offer at the top of its 28-35 zloty price range.
Analysts have said such news might give the market a psychological boost, but the information might have come too late to affect Wednesday's trade.
